Chinaready logo system
Copyright (c) Chinaready. All rights reserved.

These brand assets are provided for internal use at Chinaready and for
authorised partner and vendor use in the course of business with
Chinaready.

You MAY:
  - Display these marks on websites, applications, slide decks,
    documents, business cards, and signage referencing Chinaready or
    its products and services.
  - Reproduce these marks at any size at or above the minimum
    reproduction size documented in README.md, in their original
    colors (navy #0C1E3E and white #FFFFFF) or as the documented
    monochrome black / white variants.
  - Reformat these marks into PDF, EPS, or any other vector / raster
    container, provided the original geometry and colors are preserved.

You MAY NOT:
  - Modify the geometry, proportions, or colors of these marks.
  - Apply gradients, shadows, filters, outlines, or other decoration.
  - Use these marks in any context that implies endorsement of a
    product, service, or organisation not owned by Chinaready.
  - Use these marks in any context that is illegal, defamatory,
    discriminatory, or that violates the policies of Chinaready or
    its partners.
  - Redistribute this asset bundle outside your organisation without
    written permission from Chinaready.

Brand contact: ask your account representative.
